2024 is a leap year, so Feb has 29 days.  
From 2024-02-11:  
Days in Feb remaining: 29 - 11 = 18 → 226 - 18 = 208 days left.  
March (31) + April (30) + May (31) + June (30) + July (31) = 153 days → 208 - 153 = 55 days left.  
August 31 days → 55 - 31 = 24 days left → September 24 → 2024-09-24.  

FINAL_ANSWER: 2024-09-24
